next.reason: 1985 GR1: 'The end program header must be present in every program which either contains or is contained within another program.' §2023:10.7.3 SR1: 'An end marker shall be present in every source unit that contains, is contained in, or precedes another source unit.' The 'precedes' case is not new for 1985 programs (error mode a): by the 1985 format (§1985:X.2.3.1) a source-program written after a program without an end program header is contained in it, which needs the header, and §1985:X.2.5.4 GR4 lets a separately compiled program follow only one 'terminated by the end program header' ('it must be the Identification Division header of a program to be compiled separately'). The same 1985 texts are accepted and refused. Same.
